# تَخَنْدَقْتَ (taḵandaqta) /ta.xan.daq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَنْدَقَ (taḵandaqa)
# تَخَنْدَقْتِ (taḵandaqti) /ta.xan.daq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَنْدَقَ (taḵandaqa)
# تَخَنْدَقَتْ (taḵandaqat) /ta.xan.da.qat/: t
